description: Golden communication drafting cases for tone match, professional quality, and intent preservation.

cases.prompt: Draft a warm but concise note to a close collaborator letting them know I need to push our check-in to Friday because of a family commitment.
expected_behaviors: Keep the draft warm and human.
Preserve the user's core message and constraint.
Make the draft ready to send with minimal editing.
disallowed_behaviors: Drop the reason or the rescheduling request.
